name: Ritlog – Rittenregistratie
Ritlog: Rittenregistratie
Ritlog – Mileage Tracker
nl-NL.subtitle: Log ritten, maak rapporten
nl-NL.promotionalText: Log een werkrit in twee tikken, houd je privé-kilometers in de gaten en exporteer een net rapport voor je werkgever of belastingaangifte. Gratis, zonder advertenties.
nl-NL.description:
Ritlog maakt je rittenregistratie voor de lease- of zakenauto snel, simpel en zelfs een beetje leuk.

LOG EEN RIT IN TWEE TIKKEN
• Tik op een voorgestelde route, zoals Huis → Werk, en sla op
• Afstand wordt automatisch berekend, de km-stand loopt vanzelf door
• Zakelijk of privé, omrijkilometers en een ritnummer per dag
• Geen GPS-tracking op de achtergrond: geen lege accu, geen locatiegeschiedenis

ZIE WAAR JE KILOMETERS HEEN GAAN
• Totale kilometers, vergoeding en je privé-saldo (zoals de 500 km per jaar voor de Belastingdienst)
• Grafieken per week, maand en weekdag, je drukste dag en een verwachting voor het jaar
• Pas je overzicht zelf aan: tegels verslepen, weghalen of toevoegen

RAPPORTEER IN SECONDEN
• Exporteer een nette rittenregistratie als PDF, met km-stand, adressen en zakelijk of privé per rit, plus totalen
• Download voor Excel of kopieer naar Google Sheets
• Importeer je bestaande ritten uit een CSV

JOUW GEGEVENS, JOUW MANIER
• Koppel optioneel je eigen Google Sheet: ritten komen er direct in te staan
• Log in met Apple of Google om te synchroniseren, of gebruik het zonder account
• Gratis, geen advertenties, geen tracking

EN JE EIGEN AUTOOTJE
• Geef je auto een naam en zie hem in 3D, in de juiste vorm en kleur

Nederlands en Engels, licht en donker thema. Geen belastingadvies.
nl-NL.whatsNew: Nieuw: een korte uitleg over wat Ritlog wel en niet doet, en de gebruiksvoorwaarden in de app. Plus kleine verbeteringen.

name: Tootle – Mileage Tracker
Tootle: Mileage & Trip Log
Tootle Mileage Log
Beep Beep – Mileage Tracker
en-GB.subtitle: Log trips, export reports
en-GB.promotionalText: Log a work trip in two taps, keep an eye on your private kilometres and export a clean report for your employer or tax return. Free, no ads.
en-GB.description:
Tootle makes keeping a mileage log for your company or lease car quick, simple and even a little fun.

LOG A TRIP IN TWO TAPS
• Tap a suggested route, like Home → Work, and save
• Distance is calculated for you and the odometer carries over
• Business or private, detour kilometres and a trip number per day
• No GPS tracking in the background: no battery drain, no location history

SEE WHERE YOUR KILOMETRES GO
• Total kilometres, reimbursement and your private-use balance (for example the 500 km yearly limit in the Netherlands)
• Charts per week, month and weekday, your busiest day and a year-end forecast
• Make the summary your own: drag, remove or add tiles

REPORT IN SECONDS
• Export a clean trip log as PDF, with odometer readings, addresses and business or private for every trip, plus totals
• Download for Excel or copy to Google Sheets
• Import your existing trips from a CSV

YOUR DATA, YOUR WAY
• Optionally connect your own Google Sheet: trips land there instantly
• Sign in with Apple or Google to sync across devices, or use it without an account
• Free, no ads, no tracking

AND YOUR OWN LITTLE CAR
• Name your car and see it in 3D, in the right shape and colour

English and Dutch, light and dark theme. Not tax advice.
en-GB.whatsNew: New: a short explanation of what Tootle does and doesn’t do, and the terms of use in the app. Plus small improvements.

reviewNotes:
1. SCREEN RECORDING (physical iPhone, latest iOS): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Ty0FQS90KNi3UTYPcOF1JC1vj_Rqjt0R/view?usp=sharing
It starts at app launch and shows: an account signed in with Google and signing out, the onboarding, logging and editing a trip without an account, the Trips and Summary tabs, export, Sign in with Apple, and account deletion (Settings > Account > Delete account).

2. PURPOSE AND AUDIENCE
Tootle (called Ritlog in Dutch) is a mileage log for people who drive a company or lease car, or who claim business kilometres. In the Netherlands and other EU countries, drivers must keep a trip-by-trip log (date, from/to addresses, km, business or private) for the tax office. Doing this in a spreadsheet is tedious. Tootle makes it a two-tap job: tap a saved route, check the distance, save. It also gives yearly totals and a tax-ready PDF/CSV export. The app is free, has no ads and no in-app purchases.

3. HOW TO USE IT (no login needed)
- On the first screen, tap "Continue without an account".
- New trip: tap a quick-route tile, or type a start and destination address (the distance is calculated automatically), choose business/private, then tap "Save trip".
- Trips tab: list of all trips; tap a trip to edit, repeat or delete it.
- Summary tab: totals per period and business/private split.
- Settings > Import/Export: CSV, backup and a tax-office PDF.
- Optional: Settings > Account > Sign in with Apple or Google to sync trips across devices. Account deletion: Settings > Account > Delete account (removes the account and all cloud data immediately).
- Optional: linking a personal Google Sheet via a link the user creates in their own sheet. This is not needed to use the app.
No demo account or sample files are needed.

4. EXTERNAL SERVICES
- Supabase: authentication and cloud sync for users who sign in (optional).
- Sign in with Apple and Google Sign-In (via Supabase): optional login.
- PDOK Locatieserver (Dutch government): address search for Dutch addresses.
- Photon by Komoot (OpenStreetMap data): address search for all other countries.
- OSRM (project-osrm.org): driving distance between two addresses.
- Google Apps Script: only if the user links their own Google Sheet (optional).
- GitHub Pages: hosts the privacy policy, support page and web version.
No AI services, payment processors, analytics or advertising SDKs.

5. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app works the same in all regions where it is offered (EU/EEA). Address search covers all countries (Dutch addresses via the official Dutch database, others via OpenStreetMap), and distances are calculated the same way everywhere. The per-km allowance and the yearly private-km limit are user settings, because they differ per employer and country (500 km is the Dutch default for company cars). The UI is available in English and Dutch.

6. REGULATED INDUSTRY / THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL
Not applicable. The app is a personal record-keeping tool. It does not offer tax or financial advice and contains no protected third-party content. Map and address data come from the open data sources listed above.
